test_title: PYST 67: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figure below. Find the number on the face opposite to '7'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/913e066987c29b089e73f71a8be3bc095d0c6acf1c9f41a16feed09d2b28d450.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 8 and 9 are common on both the dices, it is clear that the remaining i.e. 7 will be opposite to 10.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5f038f1ff092b0ae3ac6f31fd6e7436f20a118decc41ff0b815d33559408f4b.png] 

So, the opposite side of "7" will be side "10".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
